name: Venice Balance
author: Fidel Ramos
description: Venice.ai credit balance — DIEM and USD — in the Omarchy bar, with a token setup panel.

barWidget.description: Remaining DIEM and USD at a glance. The ring shows the current DIEM epoch allocation; click for both balances, token setup and quick links.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often the balance is re-read. Requests are paused automatically after an authentication failure.

schema.label: Bar label
schema.description: none: the ring only. auto: percent of the DIEM epoch left, or USD when not staking. percent: the same, always. usd, diem: one amount. both: DIEM and USD. Always hidden on a vertical bar.

schema.label: Low-balance threshold (% DIEM left)
schema.description: At or below this percentage of the current DIEM allocation the ring turns urgent.

schema.label: Token storage
schema.description: keyring: the system Secret Service (gnome-keyring), no plaintext on disk. file: a 0600 file in ~/.local/state/venice, for hosts where the keyring is locked or unavailable.

schema.label: Install the Venice.ai app automatically
schema.description: After the first successful balance, create or update a Venice.ai launcher that opens https://venice.ai/chat. Runs once; turn off to leave your app launcher untouched.
